a.text: Lowell State College and Lowell Textile Institute merged into University of Lowell.

b.text: The name was changed to the University of Massachusetts Lowell when the institution joined the University of Massachusetts system.

a.text: Daniel H. O'Leary oversaw the transition from four-year teachers college to comprehensive state college.

b.text: The legislature reorganized the Normal School into Lowell State College.
